description: Add a global navigation sidebar to the Master Slide of the 'Employee Handbook' presentation. Open the 'employee_handbook.odp' file, go to Master View, and add a blue vertical rectangle on the left side of the master slide. On top of this sidebar, add two text links: 'Home' (linking to the first slide) and 'Contact' (linking to the last slide, 'HR Contacts'). Save the result as 'employee_handbook_nav.odp'. Ensure these elements appear on every slide via the Master Slide, not by copying them to individual slides.
